controls01_fix_verification.evidence: The terminal Result is no longer required to be RankDeficient, but the test still unconditionally requires capture.refusal and reads its free_ids. controls01_fix_verification.evidence: The G4 helper now reads actual upper/lower structural-area and wet-fraction bits from base_core_operands, maps roles to [0,1,2,6,7,8], and the certificate checks exact wetness plus exact-zero effective dry area.
